_comment: Community ETLs offered in the infra-TAK ETL catalog. Each one is pinned to a commit SHA and passes /module-scan before it is added or bumped. The prefix must be unique: CloudTAK keys integrations by prefix, and a fork of a COE ETL must not collide with the COE one.

entries.name: CalTopo Two-Way Sync (community)
entries.author: Paul (clptak)
entries.note: Fork of COE CalTopo: adds TAK->CalTopo Mission Sync, PLI forwarding to CalTopo Trackable Devices, and CalTopo App Tracks as live positions. Pinned to a branch SHA because the fork has no release tag yet.
